FISHERY_TYPE_DESCRIPTION: Fish is caught in national jurisdiction areas (NJA) of the flag state, by vessels with a length overall between 15 m and 24 m, and sold at landing sites, at markets, to processing factories, or exported
GEAR_GROUP_DESCRIPTION: A subset of ISSCFG 02 (seine nets), 03 (trawls), 05 (lift nets), 07 (falling gear), 08 (traps), and 10 (miscellaneous gear)
TARGET_SPECIES_DESCRIPTION: Targeting black marlin (BLM), blue marlin (BUM), striped marlin (MLS), Indo-Pacific sailfish (SFA) or any combination of these species
